3faf426d0c2fedbdd97fdc2aa6ae43eef323b78d.summary: This is a code repository landing page for a project titled Tor Socket Server Emulator For WannaCry 2.0, tagged malware, ransomware, reversing, server and wannacry. It lists a README, a PHP server file and an include folder, plus a commit history. The page gives no threat analysis, actor attribution, victims, sectors, dates of attacks, indicators or vulnerabilities.

3f3aed9ad668eda74e5140d895f2b5d6b5d11271.summary: A tutorial blog post, not a threat report. It walks through a simple proof-of-concept Windows keylogger written in C, which logs keystrokes to a local text file, and says it is for educational purposes. It mentions other malware and groups only in passing, with no analysis of them, and it is not an intelligence report on any actor, campaign or incident.
hedges: This is a practical case for educational purposes only.
